For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, while Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so.
